## Implementation Checklist

### Phase 1: Understanding (🔍)
- [ ] Research historical context and motivation
- [ ] Document mathematical foundations
- [ ] Create architectural diagrams
- [ ] Identify key learning outcomes

### Phase 2: Building (🔨)
- [ ] `src/config.py` - Configuration management
- [ ] `src/data_loader.py` - Data handling
- [ ] `src/model.py` - Core model implementation
- [ ] `src/train.py` - Training orchestration
- [ ] `src/evaluate.py` - Evaluation and testing
- [ ] `src/visualize.py` - Educational visualizations

### Phase 3: Demonstrate Strength (💪)
- [ ] Train on datasets where model excels
- [ ] Document success metrics and analysis
- [ ] Create compelling visualizations
- [ ] Explain why the model succeeds

### Phase 4: Expose Weakness (🚧)
- [ ] Identify fundamental limitations
- [ ] Document failure cases with analysis
- [ ] Connect limitations to next model's motivation
- [ ] Create educational insights from failures
